is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 3, 5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports Vgsc-L995F, Vgsc-N1570Y, and Ace1-G280S (page 3, 10, Figure 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 4 provides bar charts showing the number of mosquitoes genotyped (n=50 per site) and the genotype counts (homozygous mutant, heterozygous, homozygous wildtype) for Vgsc-L995F, Vgsc-N1570Y, and Ace1-G280S.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from six field sites in Côte d'Ivoire (page 5, 6).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical research article reporting new field collections and molecular analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies six sites: Agboville, Tiassalé, Azaguié, Dabou, Issia, and Soubré (page 5, 6).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new field collections and analysis.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and frequencies, are provided in the main figures (Figure 4).

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations from six sites in Côte d'Ivoire representing three agricultural practices (rice, vegetable, cocoa). The study performed WHO insecticide susceptibility bioassays and genotyped target-site mutations (Vgsc-L995F, Vgsc-N1570Y, Ace1-G280S) and measured expression levels of metabolic resistance genes.
